title: Gaussian cache reuse for cross-frame ADDs and paid history (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Several cross-frame reads of the same logical snapshot can share a transformed owned copy. This package constructs and exactly checks a module replacing **2 H2 by 3 H1**, saving about **0.991635 moment units** at the selected exponent. It records the extra owned field, three extra ordinary passes and retained normalizers; one additional H1 repair job loses the gain. An already-paid observation variant has an explicit caller precondition and unchanged return.

The written intersection-loss bound also extends Matarener's [PR #5060](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5060) from nested paths to arbitrary Clifford intermediate charts and typed-copy trees under the same common-contact constraints. All 16 selected #4470 center block-orientations retain a sharp rank-mass floor of eight. Changed contacts, helper boundaries, observations and general payload recombination remain outside that bound.

The frozen forecast includes the proposed word skeleton and predates exact Clifford realization/all-column checking. It tests a local cost prediction, not blind structural discovery. **No new κ, installed supplier or selected-frontier change is claimed.** The open handoffs target actual repeated source rows in #5125 and caller-bound paid-history observations in #4930, rather than duplicating those active construction campaigns.

## Task and overlap

Publication base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`. Live inputs are pinned at canonical `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`; the later active-feedback context is provenance pinned at `ff3cc58`. Exact blobs and SHA256 values are in `research/gaussian-cache-reuse/SOURCES.json`.

Scope is **changed** from catalogue task `centre-path-sharing`: this is a reusable local contract and a fixed-contact bound, rather than cross-call supplier savings or a historical packing-ceiling claim. It follows zxv's explicit geometric/predictive research assignment. [PR #5060](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5060) leaves the non-nested-center question open; this package extends its argument. [PR #4534](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4534) supplies the retiming contract. Separate split-contact lowering is existing work in [Discussion #5125](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125); the added construction shares a prefix across repeated reads. Paid-history work in [Discussion #4930](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4930) remains a distinct active campaign. Bounded overlap coverage and structured scope are recorded in `TASK.json`.

## Validation

- Python 3.12, standard library only: registered normal and optimized replays pass, with fresh bytecode-cache namespaces.
- Exact checks cover 256 frame pairs, 40 arbitrary input columns per orientation, wrong phase/dual/stale-snapshot controls, 6,750 chart paths/trees, all 16 selected center blocks, and outward rational price signs.
- Export inventory/hash checks and Git-free normal/optimized replay pass; committed-byte and metadata checks pass.
- The optional full-history preflight is unavailable in the local shallow checkout; this limitation is recorded. No full native/Lean/Docker/compiler/precision/tape or multiplication-theorem replay is claimed.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-cache-reuse
```

## Credit

Prepared by zxv with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The [package credit section](https://github.com/zxv/integer-mult-bounds/blob/codex/gaussian-cache-reuse/research/gaussian-cache-reuse/README.md#provenance-and-credit) links each predecessor contribution to its PR and preserves the native, Clifford, compiler and copied-center attribution. Frozen source archives and scientific receipts are unchanged.

## Open next questions

The smallest next test is one actual source row and its first two cross-frame reads: prove the row match and lifetime, freeze a shared tree and its complete incremental bill, then lower it exactly. A retained paid observation needs an exact caller relation and unchanged return. Changed contacts/helper boundaries need new intersection constraints. [README](https://github.com/zxv/integer-mult-bounds/blob/codex/gaussian-cache-reuse/research/gaussian-cache-reuse/README.md#open-next-questions) and `TASK.json` give the relevance, first steps and blockers.
